summary: A snowmobiler became lost on Vail Pass in poor conditions around Resolution Mountain, packing insufficient food and water and unfamiliar with the terrain. With 3% phone battery he shared his location with a friend, who alerted Vail Mountain Rescue; ground rescuers tracked his boot prints while Flight for Life's LifeGuard 2 helicopter spotted him from the air, landed, and flew him back to the parking lot unharmed.
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Summit County Rescue Group; Summit County Sheriff's Office; Eagle County Sheriff's Office; Flight for Life
notes: Call came in ~2:25 p.m. May 14, 2023; VMRG-led response with Summit County Rescue Group and state SAR coordinator. Fills an Eagle thin window via the VMRG browser-task pass.
